column1: # Licence classification of every Agenomic package. Single source of truth for
# path         manifest of the package, relative to the repository root, or the
#              component name for a private component that has no path here
# licence      SPDX identifier for oss, `proprietary` for cloud
# published    registry the package is published to, or `no`
# licence_file whether a LICENSE file is expected next to the manifest
# A cloud row never has a path in this repository: check-public-packages.sh
